component.title: Asset Detail Shell
component.purpose: Present a responsive detail surface with distinct preview, metadata, and activity regions.

states.description: Supporting activity is incomplete while the primary detail remains usable.
Supporting activity failed without replacing the primary detail.

behaviors.description: The primary preview, title/actions, supporting activity, and metadata remain distinct regions across desktop and mobile layouts.
Activity lifecycle states remain local to the activity region and do not replace the primary preview or metadata.
The metadata region moves below the primary task at narrow widths without clipping long content.
